newsitem.title: UK: Weak sterling helps LIFFE cocoa to late rises.
newsitem.headline: Weak sterling helps LIFFE cocoa to late rises.

text.p: Sterling's weakness helped LIFFE cocoa to a late jump which pushed most contracts well into positive territory, traders said.
Active May last traded six stg up at 880 stg and May volume was 2,229 lots of a total 5,156.
"It's just sterling," one said. Another reckoned sustained sterling weakness against the German mark would bring industry buyers into the market.
The UK currency lost five pfennigs from its day's high against the mark as foreign exchange markets' hopes of an early interest rate rise faded.
The rise followed a lacklustre day and London traders were still hoping New York would provide the next impetus.
Without a push from New York, or more sterling inspired industry buying, they are looking for consolidation at current levels
